entities.name: Theros
entities.description: An ancient-Greek-themed plane with a surface world and an Underworld.

entities.name: The Underworld
entities.description: The underworld of Theros, the focus of the set's story.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker held in the Underworld who breaks free and defeats Heliod.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: The Therosian god of destiny, whose return is a major plot point.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god of Theros defeated by Elspeth with a weapon made from her past traumas.

entities.name: Dan Wells
entities.description: Author who finished the background story for the set.
